records.summary: Italian multipurpose high-energy astronomy satellite conducting X-ray and gamma-ray observations from 2007 to 2024. Testing dark-matter models in Andromeda; objective, with no independent result verified

records.name: ROSAT
records.summary: Historical German–US–UK soft-X-ray and extreme-ultraviolet astronomy satellite, operating from 1990 to 1999. ROSAT hot-gas imaging provided evidence for gravitational potentials and dark-matter halos in galaxies and groups, and survey archives for later cosmology. Included here for gravity and structure research, without claiming observation of particle-dark-matter X-ray decay.
physics_targets: Total gravitational mass of galaxy groups and clusters
Spatial distributions of dark and visible matter
